metadata.title: EF-REG-022 - Over-threshold submission creates one linked approval task
titlePath: EF-REG-022 - Over-threshold submission creates one linked approval task

payload.elementDescription: The New Expense navigation item in the LEFT sidebar, a medium-sized link below My Expenses and above the MANAGER section; it is the only employee-side creation route and is separate from the selected Approvals item lower in the sidebar.

The empty Description text field in the CENTER form card, directly below the New expense heading and above the Category dropdown; it shows the placeholder 'e.g. Mumbai customer dinner' and is to the left of the Amount field.

The Amount number field in the CENTER form card, to the RIGHT of the Category dropdown and directly above the Submit Expense button; it currently displays 4800 and is separate from the Description field on the left.

The blue 'Submit Expense' button at the BOTTOM-RIGHT of the New expense form card, below the receipt area and to the right of the Cancel button; it submits the prepared EFREG022-ApprovalLink-EFQA-20260925T1245 expense and is distinct from the sidebar navigation links.

payload.script: const body=document.body.innerText; const hits=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('body *')).filter(e=>{const t=(e.innerText||'').trim(); return t.includes('EXP-1039') && t.includes('EFREG022-ApprovalLink-EFQA-20260925T1245') && t.length<1800;}).sort((a,b)=>a.innerText.length-b.innerText.length); const el=hits[0]||null; return {href:location.href,matchCount:hits.length,cardText:el?el.innerText:null,links:el?Array.from(el.querySelectorAll('a,button')).map(x=>({tag:x.tagName,text:(x.innerText||'').trim(),href:x.href||null,aria:x.getAttribute('aria-label')})):[],bodyHasTask:body.includes('101661275')};

payload.elementDescription: The 'Task #101661275' Action Center task link inside the fresh EXP-1039 approval card in the CENTER-RIGHT area, beneath the card's Receipt row and above the approval reason; it is the task link for EFREG022-ApprovalLink-EFQA-20260925T1245, not the neighboring EFREG023 task link on the card to the right.

The 'Open expense' link inside the fresh EXP-1039 card in the CENTER area, below the Approval reason and above the Comments box; this link belongs to EFREG022-ApprovalLink-EFQA-20260925T1245, not the neighboring EFREG023 card to the right.

payload.script: const text=document.body.innerText; const nodes=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('body *')).filter(e=>{const t=(e.innerText||'').trim(); return t && (t.includes('ApprovalTaskId')||t.includes('101661275')||t.includes('Pending Approval')||t.includes('Waiting on a manager'));}).slice(0,30).map(e=>({tag:e.tagName,text:(e.innerText||'').trim().slice(0,500),attrs:Array.from(e.attributes||[]).reduce((o,a)=>(o[a.name]=a.value,o),{})})); return {href:location.href,body:text.slice(0,4000),matches:nodes};

const text=document.body.innerText; const key='EFREG022-ApprovalLink-EFQA-20260925T1245'; const task='101661275'; const cards=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('article,section,[class*="card"]')).map(e=>(e.innerText||'').trim()).filter(t=>t.includes(key)); return {href:location.href,descriptionCount:(text.match(new RegExp(key,'g'))||[]).length,taskCount:(text.match(new RegExp(task,'g'))||[]).length,cardCount:cards.length,cards:cards.map(t=>t.slice(0,900)),freshExpenseCount:(text.match(/EXP-1039/g)||[]).length};

payload.elementDescription: The 'Open expense' link inside the only EFREG022-ApprovalLink-EFQA-20260925T1245 card in the CENTER area, below the approval reason and above the decision buttons; it is paired with EXP-1039 and Task #101661275, not the adjacent EFREG023 card.
